lines.t: [Intro: Grand Piano and Cello Solo]
I have seen and I have heard
I will not let this heart be stirred by shadows
Oh My beloved, My treasure, My sheep
I weep for the secrets you try to keep
Why have you wandered so far from My side?
Come out of the darkness, there's no need to hide.
Come home, My beloved, there’s no time to wait
The Father is calling, it’s not yet too late
[Female Harmony: Ethereal]
(I’m coming home)
[Female Harmony: Ethereal]
(I’m coming home)
I am the Savior, the One you desire
I’ll pull you from water, I’ll walk through the fire.
[Break: Cello Solo]
I’ve been so lost in the world and its lies
Searching for something with tear-blinded eyes
I hear Your voice calling my name through the rain
Can You really wash away all of this stain?
Rest now, My child.
You are Mine.
[End]
